rules.title: Own the copied components
rules.text: Treat components added by the shadcn CLI as project code: edit them in place and keep them in the shared ui folder.

rules.title: Compose classes with cn
rules.text: Merge conditional classes with the cn helper (clsx plus tailwind-merge) so later classes override earlier ones.

rules.title: Variants with cva
rules.text: Express component variants with class-variance-authority instead of ad hoc conditionals.

rules.title: Keep Radix accessibility
rules.text: Do not strip Radix primitives, roles or keyboard handling when restyling; extend them through props and asChild.

rules.title: Theme through CSS variables
rules.text: Change colors and radii through the theme CSS variables rather than editing utility classes in each component.
